claim: A Head-to-Head view was added
The Head-to-Head view opens from a 'Head-to-Head →' button under Kick Off on the setup screen
The Head-to-Head view runs in headless Chrome at desktop width with no console errors
The Head-to-Head view runs in headless Chrome at phone width with no console errors
Nothing has been committed
The campaign dataset only has squads and each club's real-life finish, not match results
The view plays each of the 368 campaigns through the existing sim() engine once
Each campaign is simmed with that squad as the drafted club
sim() records every opponent the drafted club faced
sim() gives the same result every time
The head-to-head record does not change between visits
For clubs A and B, the view shows B as an opponent in A's runs and A as an opponent in B's runs
Results are always scored from A's side
Simming everything takes about 30ms
Results are cached per format
The view includes two club dropdowns with flags
The view includes a swap button
The view includes a toggle for three formats: 15-0, 13-0, 20-0
The format toggle is linked to the one on the setup screen
The summary shows A wins, draws, and B wins
The summary shows a bar in green/amber/red matching the results
The summary shows both clubs' totals for goals
The summary shows both clubs' totals for knockout ties won decided on aggregate then penalties
The summary shows both clubs' totals for finals won
The summary shows both clubs' biggest win
The summary shows how many meetings came in each club's own runs
Meetings are grouped by the campaign they came from (club and season)
Each group shows the real-life finish as a tag next to where the sim run ended
Each game shows the round and leg
Each game shows the score
Each game shows a win/draw/loss badge for A
Each game shows the aggregate and penalty result where they apply
The drafted club's name is displayed in bold
Swapping A and B gives exactly mirrored totals in all three formats
The goal totals match the list of games
Changing clubs was tested
Changing format was tested
The empty state was tested
The back button was tested
sim() only draws opponents from a fixed list of 18 big clubs
Two clubs both outside the fixed list of 18 can never meet in the sim
Celtic and Rangers are an example pair that can never meet
The view explains when two clubs can never meet instead of showing zeros
